name: JIADE LIMITED Common stock
summary: JIADE Limited, operating through its various subsidiaries, offers extensive educational assistance to adult learning institutions throughout China. Its core offering centers around the advanced KB Platform, complemented by a suite of additional services. The KB Platform is designed to streamline a wide array of administrative and student-focused processes, including admissions guidance, collecting student data, monitoring enrollment status, tracking academic progress, facilitating grade inquiries, and overseeing graduation procedures. Beyond the platform, JIADE also provides valuable support before enrollment, such as advising on institutional selection and application strategy development, delivering preparatory courses for entrance examinations, and assisting with the application submission process. For enrolled students, the company offers in-person tutoring, manages exam logistics, provides supervision for graduation theses, and helps arrange practical experience opportunities. Founded in 2023, JIADE's headquarters are located in Chengdu, China.
